theorem_bundle.name: QALL_FUTURE_DEPENDENCY_BLOCK_COMPLETENESS_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: After B2B2-A confluence and B2B2-B new-seed identity erasure, the connected components of the current sealed C2 graph Q_ALL are exactly the maximal connected blocks of the complete declared future dependency hypergraph for R1/R2/B0/C0/C2/C3/B2A/B2B1/reconstruction.
proof: Unary fixed effects chi_S, chi_X0, A and source-list class do not couple distinct live vertices.
Every dynamic proper-coloring constraint is one edge of G[U], copied into Q_ALL.
Every residual-component semantic/reconstruction scope is D_C. Q_ALL represents this by one carrier node [C] adjacent exactly to D_C.
C3 selector scopes are subsets/refinements of the same D_C carrier scope; B2A component signatures use the same C,D_C neighborhood data.

B0's mutable hard coordinates are survivor relational structure and survivor-to-component incidence, represented respectively by dynamic edges and u-[C] incidences in Q_ALL. Frozen original provenance is per-vertex metadata.
B2B2-B removed any growing newly-forced-seed identity dependency; the full historical B1 grammar remains explicitly outside the future contract.
Therefore every nontrivial joint support hyperedge is contained in one Q_ALL connected component.
theorem_bundle.future_complete_firewall: Current H* connected components are insufficient because a component with MIN_BAD(C)=empty has no current selector but a future fixed/X0 change may make its message nontrivial. Q_ALL retains [C]-D_C incidence regardless of current selector presence.

theorem_bundle.name: FORCED_SUCCESSOR_QALL_BLOCK_INVARIANCE_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: Under every authorized future B2B1 forcing/canonical-return step, no semantic dependency is created between two distinct ancestor Q_ALL blocks.
proof: Forcing only fixes existing dynamic vertices; it never creates a dynamic graph edge.
Residual components are retained whole, removed whole, or later deleted by connectivity repair.

If vertices of a removed old residual component move to the dynamic side, every old dynamic neighbor of that component was in D_C and hence already belonged to the same ancestor Q_ALL block as [C]. Internal vertices/edges of the old component therefore remain inside that ancestor block.
For every retained component C, its future D_C is obtained by deleting fixed/deleted dynamic vertices from the old boundary; it cannot acquire a dynamic vertex from another ancestor block.
Promoted seed/X0 identities contribute only unary color effects by B2B2-B.
Deleted repair components have independent receipts and never reconnect by B2B2-A/B2B1 monotonicity.

theorem_bundle.name: CROSS_QALL_BLOCK_R1_R2_FACTORIZATION_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: Let K1,...,Kr be the Q_ALL blocks. Global forced-color reachability factors through block-local feasibility plus Boolean AND glue.
theorem_bundle.R1: If u is in block Ki, then R1_P(u,c) equals LOCAL_R1_Ki(u,c) AND the base-feasibility bit of every block Kj, j!=i.
theorem_bundle.R2_same_block: If u,v are in the same Ki, R2_P(u,v,c) equals LOCAL_R2_Ki(u,v,c) AND all other block base-feasibility bits.
theorem_bundle.R2_cross_block: If u is in Ki and v is in Kj with i!=j, then R2_P(u,v,c) equals LOCAL_R1_Ki(u,c) AND LOCAL_R1_Kj(v,c) AND all untouched block base-feasibility bits.
theorem_bundle.proof: There are no coloring/source/component constraints between different Q_ALL blocks after unary fixed effects are compiled. A global extension is exactly the disjoint union of block extensions plus the fixed assignment ledger.

theorem_bundle.name: QALL_BLOCK_RECONSTRUCTION_FACTORIZATION_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: Reconstruction obligations factor over Q_ALL blocks.
proof: Every residual component C and all vertices in D_C lie in the Q_ALL block containing [C].
C0 witness lookup and C3 reconstruction therefore use colors from one block only.
Connectivity-repair deleted components have independent frozen receipts attached to their ancestor block.
Global reconstruction is concatenation of block reconstructions plus the fixed identity-color ledger.

theorem_bundle.name: DISCONNECTED_FORCED_MULTIPLICITY_PORTFOLIO_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: Any multiplicity produced solely by independent choices in distinct Q_ALL blocks is covered by the sealed factorized-feedback portfolio: global representation/lifecycle is additive over block carriers plus O(r) Boolean/reconstruction glue and does not require Cartesian-product materialization.
theorem_bundle.strong_negative_firewall: A future strong multiplicity witness must remain superpolynomially future-distinguishable inside one connected Q_ALL block after all local sealed carriers are applied.
